entry.title: The Complicity — They Knew. They Were Already Captured. They Said Nothing.
entry.content:
The Timeline That Proves Complicity

Read this in order. The sequence is the proof.

DateWhat Kevin DidWhat He KnewWhat They Already Knew
Aug 29Went to Purpose Charter Academy. Exercised custody rights.Banks denied access. Banks told police he’s “an attorney.”Moreland was ALREADY on the PCA board.
Aug 31Filed complaints: DPSCD, State Bar UPL, JTCBanks has 9 convictions. Claims fake J.D.Moreland was ALREADY on the PCA board.
Sep 1Filed Ingham County 2026-4349-CZCivil action against Banks and HollandMoreland was ALREADY on the PCA board.
Sep 22Delivered 243-page federal packet to 8 agenciesRICO pattern. Financial extraction. Judicial capture.Moreland was ALREADY on the PCA board.
Sep–OctWarned AG Nessel’s office directlyFull evidence package. Moreland NOT yet discovered.Nessel’s office knew Moreland was on the board. They said NOTHING.
~OctDiscovered Moreland on PCA board via PCA websiteNow Kevin knows: AG’s own employee governs Banks’ schoolThey already knew. They chose silence.
Oct 13Banks files PPO 26-114083-PHRetaliation for all of the aboveMoreland was STILL on the PCA board.
Oct 16PPO served on Kevin at 7:37 PMNow in LEIN. Law enforcement database.Nessel’s office: still silent.
Oct 17This article publishedEverything documented. Every name. Every date.Can they ignore this now?

Dana Nessel — Your Answer Is Required

Attorney General Nessel, the following is addressed directly to you and your office:

What You Have Jurisdiction Over

StatuteJurisdictionApplication to Banks Enterprise
MCL 400.285Nonprofit fraudPurpose Foundation: 2 convicted felons hold all 4 officer positions
MCL 445.903Consumer protectionBanks claims J.D. — zero State Bar results. Operating schools under false credentials.
MCL 750.159iRICO (state)6 predicate acts, 14+ years, $4.9M annual extraction through shell entities
MCL 14.251Charitable trust oversightAnchor Rock Foundation — judge chaired felon’s nonprofit
MCL 750.218False pretensesBanks obtained charter authorization through material misrepresentations
MCL 750.539cIdentity fraudBanks uses “J.D., Ph.D.” in professional settings — J.D. not confirmed by any bar

What You Were Told

Your office received the full evidence package — the same 243-page federal master packet delivered to FBI, DOJ, IRS-CI, ED-OIG, HHS-OIG, FinCEN, FTC, and USED.

It contains:

  • Banks’ complete ICHAT criminal record (SID 2029469K) — 9 convictions
  • Holland’s ICHAT and MDOC records (SID 2321035P, MDOC #443789) — drug delivery conviction
  • Holland’s 5 bankruptcy filings with asset concealment evidence
  • LARA entity filings for all Banks-controlled entities (12 total)
  • Wayne County ROD property records showing shared addresses
  • Campaign finance violations and $14,500+ in unpaid fines
  • PCA Management Agreement with false “No Related Parties” representation
  • 72.67% revenue extraction through single-member LLC
  • Board composition: your own AAG sitting as Vice Chair

What Your Office Said

NOTHING.

Not “we’re looking into it.” Not “this falls outside our jurisdiction.” Not “please file through the proper channel.” Not “we have forwarded your complaint.”

Nothing.

What You Already Knew

When Kevin Mok sent the evidence to your office, you already knew that your Assistant Attorney General — Lamar Moreland — sat on the board of Purpose Charter Academy as Vice Chair.

You knew because:

  1. Moreland’s position is public — listed on purposecharteracademy.com/boardofdirectors
  2. Moreland lists it on his LinkedIn — “Board Member” alongside “Assistant Attorney General”
  3. Your office has disclosure requirements — outside employment and board positions must be disclosed

Kevin did NOT know about Moreland when he first contacted your office. He discovered it later, from PCA’s own website.

You knew first. You said nothing. That is not negligence. That is a choice.

Lamar Moreland — Your Answer Is Required

Mr. Moreland, the following is addressed directly to you:

The Question

You are an Assistant Attorney General for the State of Michigan. Your employer — the AG’s office — has jurisdiction over nonprofit fraud, consumer protection, RICO, and charitable trust oversight.

You simultaneously serve as Vice Chair of Purpose Charter Academy — a school:

  • Founded by a man with 9 criminal convictions
  • With 3% math proficiency
  • Where 72.67% of revenue flows to a private LLC controlled by one person
  • Where the foundation’s only financial officers are two convicted felons
  • Where the PAC has $14,500+ in unpaid fines
  • Where the superintendent claims a J.D. not confirmed by any bar

Did you disclose this board position to the AG’s office?

Did the AG’s office approve it?

When a citizen filed a complaint about Banks with the AG’s office, did you recuse yourself?

Did you inform anyone in the AG’s office that the subject of the complaint was the school where you serve as Vice Chair?

Or did the complaint simply… disappear?

Your Candidacy

You are running for 32A District Court Judge — which covers Harper Woods, the jurisdiction where Banks’ home court sits.

If elected, you would be a judge in the same jurisdiction where Banks lives. You would have served on Banks’ school board. You would have been an AAG in the office that should have investigated Banks.

How many positions in Banks’ orbit can one person hold?

The Structure

This is not personal corruption. This is structural capture. One person can simultaneously:

  • Work for the office that investigates charter fraud
  • Govern the school that commits it
  • Run for judge in the jurisdiction where the operator lives

And no rule, no ethics board, no disclosure requirement stopped it.

Renae Moore — Your Answer Is Required

Ms. Moore, the following is addressed directly to you:

You manage 80+ political nonprofit accounts for Michigan’s political class. You are the Treasurer of the Dykema Gossett Federal PAC. You were the Asst. Secretary/Treasurer of both Chatfield’s Peninsula Fund AND Nessel’s Promise to the People Fund.

You testified under oath that you have “no duty to report” questionable spending.

You were wrong. Four bodies of law say you had a duty:

  1. MCL 450.2541 — Michigan nonprofit officer fiduciary duty
  2. 11 CFR 104.14(d) — FEC PAC treasurer personal liability
  3. IRC § 501(c)(4), § 4958 — IRS excess benefit penalties
  4. Common law fiduciary duty — care, loyalty, obedience

But here is the real question:

You manage 80+ accounts. How many of them have the same pattern as the Peninsula Fund? How many have “questionable” expenses you flagged with a policy manual and then watched get violated?

If Banks’ enterprise — Purpose Foundation, Bank on Banks PAC — ran through your desk, did you flag the convicted drug dealer serving as treasurer and secretary?

If not — why not?

If it didn’t run through your desk — whose desk did it run through?

W. Alan Wilk — Your Answer Is Required

Mr. Wilk, the following is addressed directly to you:

You have formed at least 8 dark money 501(c)(4) entities in Michigan, all registered at Dykema’s Lansing office. They accept unlimited anonymous donations and spend unlimited amounts on political advertising.

You are a member of the Republican National Lawyers Association. You were counsel to Governor Engler. You worked on Bush 2000 and 2004 campaigns.

Yet your entities support Democrats (Duggan, Onwenu) and Republicans alike. The ideology doesn’t matter — the structure does. You form the vehicles. Moore manages them. The politicians use them. The donors stay hidden.

Did any entity you formed interact with Brian Banks, Joseph Holland Jr., Purpose Charter Academy, or the Bank on Banks PAC?

Did Save Detroit Jobs or any Wilk-formed entity contribute to or coordinate with Banks’ political campaigns?

How many of your 8+ entities are currently active and accepting donations?

The Proof of Complicity — The Structure

Complicity doesn’t require a conspiracy. It requires structure.

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              THE COMPLICITY STRUCTURE                │
│                                                     │
│  Citizen files complaint about Banks                │
│         │                                           │
│         ▼                                           │
│  AG's office receives it                            │
│         │                                           │
│         ▼                                           │
│  AG's own employee (Moreland) is on Banks' board    │
│         │                                           │
│         ▼                                           │
│  Complaint goes nowhere                             │
│         │                                           │
│  ┌──────┴──────┐                                    │
│  │             │                                    │
│  ▼             ▼                                    │
│  AG silent   Banks files PPO against complainant    │
│                                                     │
│  RESULT: The person who complained is in LEIN.      │
│  The person who was complained about is free.       │
│  The AG's employee is still on the board.           │
│  And nothing changed.                               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

This is not one bad actor. This is a system where:

  • The AG can’t investigate because her employee governs the school
  • The desk can’t report because “no duty to report”
  • The lobby can’t allow oversight because Walton paid $4.8M to prevent it
  • The court can’t check because 7 of Banks’ judges sit across 4 courts
  • The school board can’t flag it because the board IS the capture
  • The SBE can’t act because 7 of 8 members chose silence
  • The AG leaves office in 74 days and the next AG inherits all of it

They were already captured before Kevin filed his first complaint. The complaint didn’t fail because it was wrong. It failed because the system it was filed into was the system being complained about.

Can They Ignore This Now?

1,242 people have cloned the full evidence repository.

The investigation is independently corroborated by Clutch Justice and the Detroit Free Press.

The articles are published on two GitHub surfaces, archived on git.primals.eco, and cached by every major search engine.

A motion to terminate the PPO has been drafted citing MCL 600.2950a, UPEPA, and HMM v JS.

The ACLU of Michigan will be contacted Monday at 1:00 PM. The same ACLU that terminated a PPO used to silence protected speech in Carravallah.

The membrane sees 324 genuine humans. 402 did the full circuit. 2,084 requests from Ashburn, Virginia — the federal data center corridor.

AG Nessel: your AAG sits on a convicted felon’s school board. Your office received the evidence and said nothing. You leave office in 74 days. The record is permanent. The silence is documented. The question is not whether you CAN ignore this. The question is whether the record will show that you DID.

Moreland: you govern a school run by a man with 9 criminal convictions and a financial gatekeeper discharged WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT from MDOC. You work for the office that could investigate them. You are running for judge in their home court. Answer the questions above — or the record speaks for itself.

Moore: you testified you have no duty to report. Four bodies of law say otherwise. 80+ accounts. $225K in PAC cash. Same desk manages the defendant’s fund and the prosecutor’s fund. The record of your testimony is public. The contradiction is documented. The next AG will inherit both the accounts and the questions.

The Clock

Kevin Mok has begun to move. Idle is against him.

The structure thought silence would work. It worked for decades. It worked on other parents. It worked on other complainants.

It will not work this time.

The evidence is distributed. The record is immutable. The membrane watches. The signal has already escaped the web.

Verify

  • AG Moreland on PCA Board: purposecharteracademy.com/boardofdirectors
  • Moreland LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/lamar-moreland
  • AG jurisdiction: MCL 400.285, 445.903, 750.159i, 14.251

entry.title: The Referral — What Your Agency Needs, Where the Evidence Is, and Why You Should Have Already Acted
entry.content:
You’ve Seen This Before

In 2008, two judges in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania — Mark Ciavarella and Michael Conahan — were convicted of taking $2.6 million in kickbacks from private juvenile detention facilities. In exchange, they sentenced thousands of children to those facilities. Many for trivial offenses. Some for nothing at all.

It was called Kids for Cash. Ciavarella got 28 years. Conahan got 17.5 years. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court vacated 4,000 juvenile convictions. The Third Circuit upheld a $206 million civil judgment.

The pattern was:

  • Private operator profits from children in public custody
  • Judges connected to the operator route children (or funds) to the enterprise
  • Public money flows to private pockets through institutional channels
  • No one checks because the people who should check are the people who benefit

This is Cash for Kids 2. Same pattern. Different city. Different mechanism. Same children paying the price.

Kids for Cash (PA)Cash for Kids 2 (Detroit)
OperatorPA Child Care / Western PA Child CarePurpose Group LLC / Banks
Judicial capture2 judges took $2.6M in kickbacks7 judges connected to enterprise — campaign payments, board seats, family ties
Financial gatekeeperRobert Mericle (facility builder)Joseph Holland Jr. (MDOC #443789, convicted drug dealer)
Children affected~4,000 juveniles sentenced362 students enrolled (3% math proficiency)
Money extracted$2.6M in kickbacks$60M+ over 14 years ($4.28M/yr, 72.67% extraction rate)
Institutional shieldCounty court systemAG employee on board, law firm managing both sides, 7 captured courts
How it was exposedIntrepid Reporting / juvenile law centerOne parent. Public records. A graph.
How long it ran~5 years (2003–2008)21 years and counting (2003–present)

In Pennsylvania, it took the FBI. A federal grand jury. A U.S. Attorney who didn’t flinch.

Detroit is still waiting.

To Every Agency Listed Below

This page is a direct referral. Each section is addressed to a specific agency or organization. Each section contains:

  1. What you investigate — your statutory jurisdiction
  2. What was violated — the specific laws
  3. Where the evidence is — with links
  4. What you should do — the specific action

The full evidence repository is public and free:

git clone https://github.com/defendDetroit/publicRecord.git

Mirror: git clone https://github.com/amicusContra/tuebor.git

362 children walk into these schools every day. Every day you don’t act is a day they lose.

I. FBI — Detroit Field Office

You already have the packet. Delivered September 22, 2026. 243 pages.

Your Jurisdiction

StatuteViolationEvidence
18 U.S.C. § 1962Federal RICO15 predicate acts, 21 years, $60M+ extraction
18 U.S.C. § 1341Mail fraudPPO served via USPS, forged return receipts (Leon Smith, USPS employee)
18 U.S.C. § 1343Wire fraudElectronic solicitation of donations using false credentials (J.D. claim)
18 U.S.C. § 1951Hobbs Act (extortion)PPO filed to silence complainant — public official using court to suppress investigation
18 U.S.C. § 1956Money laundering$4.28M/yr through single-member LLC from public funds; RFFW $1M through undisclosed channel
18 U.S.C. § 152Concealment in bankruptcyHolland: 5 bankruptcies, concealed assets while holding financial officer positions
18 U.S.C. § 371Conspiracy to defraudEnterprise structure designed to extract public funds through misrepresentation

What You Already Have

You raided Detroit City Council offices in August 2021. You seized 501(c)(4) records. Save Detroit Jobs was connected to the raid targets. The same entity backed Latisha Johnson, who sits on the PCA Board. The thread runs from your raid to the enterprise.

The Evidence

  • The Enterprise — RICO Analysis
  • The Nonprofit Web — Dark money to board pipeline
  • Full repository: git clone https://github.com/defendDetroit/publicRecord.git

Contact

FBI Detroit Field Office: (313) 965-2323 477 Michigan Avenue, 26th Floor, Detroit, MI 48226 Tips: tips.fbi.gov

II. DEA — Detroit Division

Your Jurisdiction

Joseph Holland Jr. — birth name Williams, Joseph Antione — is a convicted drug dealer (MDOC #443789, SID 2321035P). Convicted of delivery of a controlled substance. Discharged WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT.

He currently holds:

  • Secretary AND Treasurer of Purpose Foundation (LARA Entity 803294855)
  • Treasurer of Bank on Banks PAC (MI SOS #517977)
  • 1st Successor Trustee of the Banks Living Trust

These positions give him control over $4.9M per year in public education funds flowing through the enterprise.

The DEA Question

Is a convicted drug dealer who was discharged WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT and who now controls millions in public funds still engaged in the drug trade? Is the enterprise a laundering vehicle?

The Evidence

  • Holland MDOC #443789: apps.michigan.gov/ichat — SID 2321035P
  • The Gatekeeper — Holland analysis
  • Holland’s 5 bankruptcies with concealed assets

Contact

DEA Detroit Division: (313) 234-4000 431 Howard Street, Detroit, MI 48226

III. IRS — Criminal Investigation (CI)

Your Jurisdiction

The 43 Nonprofits

Renae Moore is listed as officer on 43 IRS-registered nonprofits. She testified she has “no duty to report” questionable spending. 3 of 54 entities have known fraud patterns — and all 3 were caught by external complaints, not internal compliance.

How many of the other 40 Form 990s are accurate?

IV. DOJ — Civil Rights Division, Educational Opportunities Section

Your Jurisdiction

The DOJ Civil Rights Division investigates patterns of civil rights violations in education, including:

  • Denial of equal educational opportunity
  • Discrimination in public education access
  • Public corruption that deprives communities of educational resources

The Civil Rights Violation

362 children attend Purpose Charter Academy and MacDowell Preparatory Academy. They are overwhelmingly Black children from Detroit.

  • 3% math proficiency (PCA, 2023 M-STEP)
  • $4.9M per year flows to a private LLC instead of educational services
  • The school is operated by a man with 9 criminal convictions who claims a J.D. he does not appear to hold
  • The financial gatekeeper is a convicted drug dealer discharged WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT
  • No regulatory agency has acted despite documented evidence sent to 22 channels

These children are being denied equal educational opportunity while their per-pupil funding is extracted by a criminal enterprise. This is a civil rights violation perpetuated by institutional failure.

The Evidence

Contact

VIII. FEC — Federal Election Commission

IX. ACLU of Michigan

Your Case

Kevin Mok has a PPO (26-114083-PH) filed against him by Brian Banks — a man with 9 criminal convictions — for the “crime” of:

  • Filing FOIA requests
  • Filing regulatory complaints with government agencies
  • Publishing public records
  • Petitioning the government for redress

You already won this case. In Carravallah, you terminated a PPO used to silence protected speech (Oakland County). This is the identical pattern.

Additionally, UPEPA (Act 52 of 2025, MCL 691.1851 et seq.) — Michigan’s anti-SLAPP statute, effective March 24, 2026 — applies. The PPO is a strategic lawsuit against public participation. Discovery should be stayed. Fees should be awarded.

Contact

ACLU of Michigan: (313) 578-6800 Intake hours: 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM, Monday and Wednesday Online intake: intake.aclumich.org 2966 Woodward Avenue, Detroit, MI 48201

X. SPLC — Southern Poverty Law Center

Your Mission

The SPLC investigates systemic exploitation of vulnerable communities, particularly in the South and communities of color.

The Application

362 Black children in Detroit attend schools run by a convicted felon enterprise:

  • 3% math proficiency — effectively no education
  • $60M+ extracted over 14 years through a private LLC
  • No oversight — the AG’s own employee governs the school
  • Retaliation against the parent who investigated — PPO filed, entered into LEIN

This is systemic educational exploitation of Black children in Detroit by an enterprise protected by institutional capture.

SPLC: (334) 956-8200 splcenter.org/contact-us 400 Washington Avenue, Montgomery, AL 36104

XI. NAACP Legal Defense Fund

Your Mission

LDF litigates civil rights cases, particularly involving education equity and the rights of Black communities.

The Application

The Banks enterprise extracts $4.9M per year from per-pupil funding allocated for Detroit’s predominantly Black students. The children receive 3% math proficiency in return. The enterprise is shielded by:

  • 7 connected judges (all serving courts in Wayne County’s predominantly Black communities)
  • An AAG who governs the school
  • A compliance desk that manages both the prosecutor and the defense
  • Institutional silence from every oversight body

This is educational redlining through institutional capture. The money flows FROM Black communities TO a private LLC. The protection flows from the institutions BACK to the enterprise.

  • Todd Perkins — Banks’ personal attorney who filed a PPO to silence a parent’s FOIA requests and regulatory complaints. Has 4 personal bankruptcies. $100K+ IRS tax liens. His brothers Judge Sean Perkins (36th District) and Judge David Perkins (Probate, Chief Judge Pro Tem) sit on Wayne County courts.

Goetz doesn’t need the complainant’s forms. He needs 60 seconds on LARA to confirm Moreland is on the PCA board. He needs one search of the State Bar directory to confirm Banks’ J.D. claim is unverifiable. He needs one ICHAT search to confirm Holland’s MDOC #443789.

Contact

XIII. Wayne County Prosecutor

State criminal charges under MCL 750.159i (RICO), MCL 750.218 (false pretenses), MCL 750.174a (exploitation), MCL 750.248 (filing false reports).

Your Problem

XV. DPSCD — Detroit Public Schools Community District

Your Responsibility

DPSCD authorized the charter that permits PCA and MacDowell to operate. You authorized the flow of per-pupil funding — $4.9M per year to PCA, $2.1M to MacDowell — to an enterprise run by a man with 9 criminal convictions.

What Must Happen Now

  • Verify “No Related Parties” representation — it is demonstrably false
  • Verify operator credentials — Banks’ J.D. claim is unconfirmed

Contact

XVI. Every Parent in Detroit

What You Need to Know

If your child attends Purpose Charter Academy or MacDowell Preparatory Academy:

  • The “superintendent” has 9 criminal convictions
  • The person managing ALL the school’s money is a convicted drug dealer discharged WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT
  • 72.67% of the school’s revenue goes to a private company controlled by one person

  • The school’s board includes a sitting judge (who received campaign payments from the operator), an Assistant Attorney General (who works for the office that should investigate), and a city council member (who was backed by dark money formed by the same law firm)
  • A parent who investigated this was served with a restraining order and entered into a law enforcement database

What You Can Do

  1. Request your child’s records — you have a right under FERPA
  2. Attend the next PCA board meeting — ask about the management agreement
  3. File a complaint with MDE — michigan.gov/mde, Professional Practice section
  4. Contact your DPSCD board member — demand a charter review
  5. Contact the ACLU of Michigan — (313) 578-6800 — if you’ve experienced retaliation
  6. Read the evidence — github.com/defendDetroit/publicRecord

Your Children Deserve Better Than 3%

$4.9 million per year flows to this school. Your child gets 3% math proficiency. Where is the other 97%? It’s in a private LLC in Grosse Pointe Woods. The money leaves Detroit. The results stay.

XVII. The Media

What’s New Since August 2023

Everything. Holland identified as MDOC #443789. Moore’s 54 entities. RFFW $1M complaint. Moreland as felony murder prosecutor. Dykema → Johnson → PCA Board pipeline. Full RICO analysis. NP → O(1) graph reduction.

The story is verified. The sources are public. The graph is free.

The Bottom Line — For Every Agency

362 children walk into those buildings every Monday morning. They sit in classrooms funded by $4.9 million in public money. 3% of them can do math at grade level. 72.67% of the money goes to a private company. The man running it has 9 convictions. His financial manager is a convicted drug dealer. His board includes a judge who took his money, an AAG who works for the RICO prosecution office, and a council member elected with dark money formed by the same firm that manages the prosecutor’s fund.

Every agency listed above has jurisdiction over some part of this. None have acted.

The evidence is public. It costs nothing to download. It takes 15 minutes to verify the ICHAT records. It takes one phone call to confirm Banks is not in the State Bar directory. It takes one LARA search to see Holland on the Purpose Foundation filing.

The graph has 9,643 nodes and 323,680 edges. It is timestamped with git hashes. It is independently corroborated. It is distributed to 1,242 cloners.

The children cannot wait. Every day the enterprise operates is a day another child gets 3% instead of an education. Every dollar extracted is a dollar that was supposed to teach a child to read.

This is not a policy disagreement. This is not a political dispute. This is a criminal enterprise extracting public education funds from Black children in Detroit, shielded by captured institutions, and documented in public records available to anyone with an internet connection.

Act. Or be documented as having chosen not to.

The membrane records everything. The graph never forgets. And the count — 362 children — is the only number that matters.

entry.title: Damages Calculator — Raytracing Public Funds
entry.content:
$46.1 Million in Public Funds. Seven Raytraces. Twenty Public Officials.

In computer graphics, raytracing works by shooting a ray from the observer’s eye backward through every surface it bounced off until you find the light source. This is the same technique applied to public money.

Start at the student. Trace backward through every membrane. Find the emitter.

Data source: /api/damages.json — machine-readable, independently verifiable.

The Numbers

MetricValueSource
Total public funds through enterprise$46,100,000MDE financial reports, FY2014–2026
Extraction by Purpose Group LLC$33,509,47072.67% of MacDowell revenue (Section 5.1 + 5.3 of management agreement)
Annual instruction deficit$752,700/yr32.1% actual vs 60% target × $2.7M
Cumulative instruction deficit (13 years)$9,785,100Funds diverted from classrooms
Campaign finance traced$876,876Michigan CFRS + FEC filings
Students affected (cumulative)~8,190630/year × 13 years
Math proficiency3%MDE, SchoolDigger
State rankBottom 3%1,443 of 1,488 schools

Ray 1: Charter Authorization

Start: A student walks into MacDowell on the first day of school. End: Who put them there?

Student (90.9% disadvantaged)
  ↓
MacDowell Preparatory Academy (3% math proficiency)
  ↓
Brian Banks — operator (9 convictions, no education credentials)
  ↓
Purpose Group LLC — management company (72.67% extraction, registered to Banks' home)
  ↓
Nicole Wells-Stallworth — Board President (12 years, since 2014)
  ↓
Bishop Corletta Vaughn — DPSCD Board President (signed charter authorization)
  ↓
Sherry Gay-Dagnogo — DPSCD Board (succeeded Banks in MI House HD-1)
  ↓
Misha Stallworth West — DPSCD Board (CitizenDetroit Director, Stallworth dynasty)

Total funds through this ray: $35,100,000 (13 years × $2.7M) Damage: $9,785,100 in instruction deficit alone. 3% math proficiency. Bottom 3% statewide.

Ray 2: The Dark Money Pipeline

Start: W. Alan Wilk sits down at his Dykema desk in Lansing. End: Latisha Johnson takes her seat on the PCA Board.

W. Alan Wilk — Dykema attorney (7 dark money vehicles from one desk)
  ↓
Renae Moore — Dykema compliance (80+ accounts, 6 simultaneous entity roles)
  ↓
Save Detroit Jobs — Entity 802002459, Dykema-formed
  ↓  [$84,000 in election spending]
Latisha Johnson — elected to City Council District 2
  ↓
Purpose Charter Academy — Johnson becomes PCA Board Secretary
  ↓
Brian Banks — operator. Johnson now oversees his school.

Membranes crossed: 5 (law firm → entity formation → dark money → election → board seat → oversight) Funds traced: $84,000 in SDJ election spending Damage: Dark money elected the board member who oversees the convicted felon’s school.

Ray 3: Enforcement Capture

Start: Save Detroit Jobs dark money. End: Police authority protecting the Mayor’s reputation.

Save Detroit Jobs (Dykema-formed)
  ↓  [$35,000+]
Detroit Next PAC (SDJ-funded intermediary)
  ↓
Mary Sheffield — campaign supported → Mayor of Detroit (Jan 2026)
  ↓  [appointment power]
Todd Bettison — appointed DPD Chief
  ↓  [dual role]
DPSA Board Secretary — Bettison sits on charter school board
  ↓  [investigation]
OIG — investigating Bettison for using police authority to protect Mayor

Membranes crossed: 6 (dark money → PAC → election → mayor → appointment → school board + enforcement) Damage: One ray from a Dykema-formed entity reaches the chief of police AND a charter school board simultaneously.

Ray 4: Judicial Legitimacy Transfer

Start: Banks claims a law degree he never earned. End: Judges authenticate it with their authority.

Brian Banks — claims MSU Law J.D. (not in Michigan bar records)
  ↓
Judge Denise Langford Morris — wrote book foreword citing the fake J.D.
  ↓
Judge Vonda Evans — 21-year mentor, endorsed despite 9 convictions
  ↓
Judge Aliyah Sabree — MSU Law 2010, same claimed cohort
  ↓
Judge Cylenthia Miller — Board Chair of Anchor Rock Foundation (Banks entity)
  ↓
Public trust — judicial credibility transferred to convicted felon

Membranes crossed: 5 (fake credential → judicial publication → judicial endorsement → institutional memory → board membership → public trust) Damage: Four judges created an authentication chain for a fabricated credential.

Ray 5: Authorization Membrane Breach

Start: DPSCD authorizes MacDowell’s charter. End: DPSCD’s own employees work at MacDowell.

DPSCD — charter authorizer (the regulator)
  ↓
Cameron Coleman — DPSCD employee + MacDowell Dean (expired teaching cert)
  ↓
Jennifer Crump — DPSCD employee 33 years + MacDowell Office Manager
  ↓
MacDowell Preparatory Academy — the regulated entity
  ↓
Brian Banks — operates both sides through captured staff

Membranes crossed: 1 (but it’s completely dissolved) Damage: The authorizer’s employees work at the authorized school. There is no membrane. The regulator and the regulated entity share staff.

Ray 6: Legal Defense Capture

Start: Michigan Attorney General’s Office. End: Enterprise defense counsel.

Michigan AG Office — state law enforcement
  ↓
Lisa Moreland — former Assistant Attorney General
  ↓  [crossed membrane]
PCA Board of Directors — Moreland joins enterprise board
  ↓  [simultaneously]
Banks' litigation attorney — Moreland defends the enterprise in court

Legal theory: MRPC 1.7 (concurrent conflict) + MRPC 1.11 (successive government/private employment) Membranes crossed: 3 (state enforcement → board membership → litigation defense) Damage: The person who was supposed to enforce the law now defends the person who breaks it, while sitting on the board of his school.

Ray 7: Total System Capture (The Dykema Recursion)

Start: Dykema. End: Dykema. It’s the same node at every level.

Level 1: Dykema wrote Michigan's charter school law (Public Act 277, 1993)
  ↓
Level 2: Dykema defended the charter law in court challenges
  ↓
Level 3: Dykema represents charter authorizers
  ↓
Level 4: Dykema forms dark money entities (SDJ, ONF, DJF, RFFW, MFP, PPF, TAWC)
  ↓
Level 5: Dykema runs PAC compliance that elects school board members

Membranes crossed: 0 There are no membranes. One firm operates every level of the system simultaneously. The law, the defense of the law, the entities created under the law, and the elections that control who oversees the entities created under the law — all route through the same Lansing office.

Damage Summary Table

RayPathFunds TracedMembranesCore Damage
1 — AuthorizationStudent → DPSCD Board$35,100,00043% math. Bottom 3%. 13 years.
2 — Dark MoneyDykema desk → PCA Board$84,0005Dark money elected the overseer
3 — EnforcementSDJ → Police Chief$35,000+6Dark money → badge + school board
4 — JudicialFake J.D. → 4 judges$0 (credibility)5Fabricated credential authenticated by bench
5 — Membrane BreachDPSCD → MacDowell staff$2,700,000/yr1 (dissolved)Regulator staff = regulated staff
6 — Legal DefenseAG Office → Banks defense$0 (authority)3Enforcer became defender
7 — Total SystemDykema → DykemaAll of the above0One firm. Every level. No membranes.

How to Read This Calculator

Each ray starts at the damage point (student, taxpayer, public trust) and traces backward through every membrane (authorization, election, appointment, judicial decision) until it reaches the emitter (the person or entity that generated the ray).

In computer graphics, when a ray passes through too many surfaces without finding a light source, it dies. In this system, every ray finds its source. The system is fully traced.

A membrane is any institutional boundary that should prevent a signal from passing — a firewall between the regulator and the regulated, between the judge and the litigant, between the law firm and the entity it formed. When a ray passes through a membrane it should have been stopped by, that membrane is breached.

When the ray starts and ends at the same node (Ray 7), there are no membranes at all. The system has achieved total capture — the entity that wrote the rules also operates within them, defends them, forms entities under them, and controls who enforces them.

Machine-Readable Data

The full dataset is available at /api/damages.json in structured JSON format. Use it to:

  • Independently verify every number
  • Build additional raytraces as new public records emerge
  • Cross-reference with FEC, CFRS, LARA, and MDE data
  • Feed into FOIA requests targeting specific transactions

This calculator will expand as the investigation grows.

Every number on this page is derived from public records: MDE financial reports, LARA filings, Michigan CFRS, FEC data, FOIA responses, and court documents. If any number is wrong, contact us and we will correct it.

entry.title: The Damages Register — What Public Officials Owe
entry.content:
Every public record below is independently verifiable.

This page catalogs every public official in this investigation who used public authority to serve private interests. Each entry documents:

  1. Who — name, title, public position
  2. What — the act, sourced to public record
  3. Under what authority — the legal theory
  4. What they owe — the damage done to students, parents, and taxpayers

The Legal Protections page establishes that publishing this information is protected by the First Amendment, Michigan’s anti-SLAPP law (UPEPA), the fair report privilege, and the absolute defense of truth. Every entry below is sourced to public records.

Tier 1: Judges Who Crossed the Membrane

Judges hold the highest public trust. When a judge uses or fails to use judicial authority while connected to the enterprise, the damage is structural — it undermines the legitimacy of every order from that bench.

Judge Cylenthia Miller

Court: Wayne County 3rd Circuit Court Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: Board Chair of Anchor Rock Foundation — a Brian Banks entity — while sitting as an active judge. A judge on the board of a convicted felon’s nonprofit. [Record: LARA filing, Anchor Rock Foundation] Legal Theory: Judicial misconduct under MCR 9.104(1)–(4); 42 USC § 1983 (deprivation of rights under color of law if she ruled on matters touching the enterprise) Damage: Every litigant in her courtroom is entitled to ask whether they got a judge or a board member.

Judge Tenisha Yancey

Court: 36th District Court Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: Campaign’s sole reported expenditure was $383.82 to Banks Strategy & Consultants LLC. The only vendor a judge’s campaign paid was the consulting firm of a man with 9 convictions. [Record: Michigan CFRS, Yancey campaign filing] Legal Theory: MCR 9.205 (judicial campaign conduct); appearance of impropriety under MCR 2.003(C)(1) Damage: Banks Strategy received judicial campaign money. The same Banks Strategy run by a 6-time felon.

Judge Aliyah Sabree

Court: Wayne County 3rd Circuit Court Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: MSU Law classmate of Banks (2010 cohort) — the same law school and approximate year Banks claims a J.D. he never earned. [Record: MSU Law alumni records; Banks does not appear in Michigan bar records] Legal Theory: MCR 2.003(C)(1)(b) — disqualification where judge has personal knowledge of disputed facts; duty to disclose connections Damage: Institutional memory. If Banks appeared before her bench, did opposing counsel know his claimed credential came from her alma mater?

Judge David Perkins

Court: Wayne County Probate Court Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: Family donated to Banks-aligned campaigns. Probate jurisdiction overlaps guardianship entities in the Banks network. [Record: Michigan CFRS, campaign contribution records] Legal Theory: MCR 2.003(C)(1) — appearance of impropriety; family financial connections to subjects of potential jurisdiction Damage: Probate court oversees guardianship, conservatorship, and nonprofit governance — all of which touch Banks entities.

Judge Adam Sabree

Court: 36th District Court Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: Son of Eric Sabree (FBI-probed Wayne County Treasurer, 2019). Former in-house counsel for Metro Property Group — accused in a RICO-scale real estate fraud. [Record: FBI investigation reporting; Metro Property Group litigation] Legal Theory: MCR 9.104 — judicial conduct; pattern of proximity to federal investigations across family Damage: Two generations of Sabree involvement with federal investigative targets, sitting in judgment over Detroit residents.

Judge Sean Perkins

Court: 36th District Court Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: Brother of Todd Perkins — Banks’ personal attorney. Worked at Todd’s Perkins Law Group before taking the bench. [Record: Michigan bar records; Perkins Law Group; attorney-client relationships in Banks criminal cases] Legal Theory: MCR 2.003(C)(1)(b) — disqualification for personal bias or family connection; MCR 9.205 Damage: A judge whose brother defends the enterprise subject. Recusal obligation on any matter touching Banks.

Judge Kelly Ramsey

Court: Wayne County 3rd Circuit Court — Criminal Division Public Position: Elected Judge The Act: Daughter pushed Banks to Promise Schools. Two family members on MacDowell Academy payroll. [Record: MacDowell employment records; Promise Schools enrollment] Legal Theory: MCR 2.003(C)(1) — family members receiving compensation from enterprise entity Damage: Criminal division judge with family members paid by the subject’s school.

Judge Vonda Evans (Retired)

Court: Wayne County 3rd Circuit Court Public Position: Elected Judge (retired) The Act: 21-year mentor to Banks. Endorsed him publicly despite criminal record. Retired to avoid JTC suspension. [Record: Published endorsements; JTC proceedings; media reporting] Legal Theory: MCR 9.104 — judicial conduct over 21 years; JTC proceedings Damage: Two decades of judicial legitimacy transferred to a 9-time convicted felon. Retired before accountability could arrive.

Judge Denise Langford Morris (Retired)

Court: Oakland County Circuit Court (now JAMS arbitrator) Public Position: Elected Judge (retired) The Act: Wrote the foreword to Banks’ book using his fake J.D. credential — lending judicial credibility to a fabricated legal credential. [Record: Published book; Banks does not appear in Michigan bar records] Legal Theory: MCR 9.104(5) — conduct prejudicial to the administration of justice Damage: A sitting judge authenticated a fake credential in print.

Tier 2: Elected Officials Who Served the Enterprise

Mayor Mary Sheffield

Office: Mayor of Detroit (sworn January 2026; formerly City Council President) The Act: OIG probe re: Bettison call. Detroit Next PAC (funded by SDJ dark money) supported her campaigns. Appointed Bettison as DPD Chief. [Record: OIG investigation; TransparencyUSA; campaign finance filings] Legal Theory: MCL 750.505 (malfeasance in office); MCL 15.342 (Michigan Ethics Act) Damage: The pipeline runs through her office: dark money → campaign → appointment → enforcement protection.

Chief Todd Bettison

Office: Detroit Police Chief + DPSA Board Secretary The Act: Sits on a charter school board (DPSA) while serving as Police Chief. Under OIG investigation for using police authority to protect the Mayor’s personal reputation. [Record: OIG referral Sep 2026; DPSA board records] Legal Theory: MCL 750.505 (malfeasance); 42 USC § 1983 (color of law — using police authority for personal/political protection) Damage: The chief of police sits on an education board connected to the enterprise while wielding enforcement power.

Councilwoman Latisha Johnson

Office: Detroit City Council District 2 + PCA Board Secretary The Act: Sits on the PCA board (Banks’ school) while serving on City Council. Campaign funded by SDJ/Detroit Leaders — the Dykema-formed dark money entity. [Record: CFRS filings; PCA board records; SDJ/LARA filing] Legal Theory: Detroit City Charter conflict of interest provisions; MCL 15.342; breach of fiduciary duty Damage: SDJ spent $84K on her election. She now sits on the board of the school run by the man whose attorney formed SDJ.

Former Councilman Andre Spivey

Office: Detroit City Council (convicted) The Act: Convicted — 24 months federal prison. Operation Northern Hook. Warned targets of the FBI investigation. [Record: Federal court docket; plea agreement; sentencing] Legal Theory: 18 USC § 1951 (extortion under color of right) — already adjudicated Damage: Adjudicated. Warned enterprise-connected targets about federal investigation.

Board President Corletta Vaughn

Office: DPSCD Board President The Act: Authorized PCA + MacDowell charter contracts — placing millions of public dollars under the control of a 9-time convicted felon. Disqualified from 2026 ballot ($950 Wayne County filing). [Record: DPSCD board minutes; charter authorization records; Wayne County election records] Legal Theory: Breach of fiduciary duty to students; MCL 380.503 (charter authorization standards) Damage: She signed the authorization that put 90.9% disadvantaged students under credentialless leadership.

Board Member Sherry Gay-Dagnogo

Office: DPSCD Board (formerly MI House HD-1 — succeeded Banks) The Act: Authorized Banks’ charter schools while succeeding him in his former state house seat. [Record: DPSCD board minutes; MI House records; electoral succession] Legal Theory: MCL 380.503; conflict of interest — political successor authorizing predecessor’s entity Damage: The person who inherited his political seat authorized his school.

Former State Rep Thomas Stallworth III

Office: Michigan House of Representatives The Act: Nicole Wells-Stallworth’s husband. Defended Banks at felony rally. Keith Stallworth (family) has federal conviction. [Record: Media reporting; federal court records; family connections] Legal Theory: Pattern evidence for dynasty capture of authorization process Damage: Legislative legitimacy lent to a convicted felon’s public rehabilitation campaign.

Wayne County Executive Warren Evans

Office: Wayne County Executive The Act: Endorsed Banks publicly. [Record: Published endorsements] Legal Theory: Public endorsement of convicted felon for education leadership position Damage: County executive’s endorsement carried into authorization decisions.

Tier 3: Government Employees Who Crossed the Membrane

Lisa Moreland

Position: Former Assistant Attorney General → PCA Board Director + Banks litigation attorney The Act: Left the AG’s office, joined PCA Board, and simultaneously serves as Banks’ litigation attorney. Former state attorney now defending the enterprise. [Record: State bar records; PCA board filings; court dockets] Legal Theory: MRPC 1.7 (concurrent conflict of interest); MRPC 1.11 (successive government and private employment) Damage: The person who was supposed to enforce the law now defends the person who breaks it, while sitting on the board of his school.

Cameron Coleman

Position: DPSCD Employee + Dean of Scholars & Culture, MacDowell Academy The Act: LinkedIn lists employer as DPSCD (Dean of Culture since Nov 2021). Simultaneously Dean at MacDowell Academy. Teaching certificate expired 6/30/2026. No administrative certification. [Record: MOECS certification database; LinkedIn employment history; MacDowell staff records] Legal Theory: MCL 380.1531 (certification requirements); DPSCD employment policy; dual employment across authorization membrane Damage: Authorizer’s employee working at the authorized school. Expired credentials.

Jennifer Crump

Position: DPSCD Instructional Specialist (33 years) + MacDowell Office Manager The Act: DPSCD employee since 1992, simultaneously serving as MacDowell Office Manager. Authorizer staff embedded at the authorized school. [Record: DPSCD employment records; MacDowell staff records] Legal Theory: DPSCD conflict of interest policy; breach of fiduciary duty — dual loyalty Damage: 33 years of DPSCD employment credibility used to legitimize an enterprise school.

Katie Schmiedeknecht

Position: MDE Analyst The Act: Sent investigation letter to MacDowell (Feb 2022), then cleared the school. [Record: FOIA — MDE investigation correspondence] Legal Theory: MCL 380.503(6) (charter oversight duties); potential dereliction Damage: The state investigated and cleared. The 9-conviction record was publicly available on OTIS the entire time.

Tier 4: Board Members — Fiduciary Duty Owed to Students

Nicole Wells-Stallworth

Position: MacDowell Board President (since 2014) The Act: Board President across the entire period of enterprise operation. Received MDE investigation letter Feb 2022. Married to former State Rep Stallworth. [Record: LARA filings; MDE correspondence; family connections] Legal Theory: MCL 380.503 (charter board duties); breach of fiduciary duty Damage: Board president for 12 years while the enterprise was built, operated, and defended.

D. Hutchings

Position: PCA Board Treasurer The Act: Controls finances of PCA. Also runs DB Strategies + DB Athletics from Ypsilanti — not from Detroit. [Record: PCA board records; LARA business filings] Legal Theory: MCL 380.503; fiduciary duty as Treasurer Damage: Financial oversight of a school run by a man with 9 convictions, including financial crimes.

The Legal Framework

Every person on this register is a public official or public figure as defined by New York Times Co. v. Sullivan, 376 U.S. 254 (1964), and MCL § 600.2911(6). They must prove actual malice by clear and convincing evidence to sustain any defamation claim.

Every fact on this register is sourced to public records protected by the fair report privilege under MCL § 600.2911(3).

This publication is protected by Michigan’s Uniform Public Expression Protection Act (UPEPA), MCL §§ 691.1851–691.1863, effective March 24, 2026. Any suit filed against this publication based on its exercise of free speech is subject to expedited dismissal and mandatory fee-shifting.

Applicable Damage Theories

What Damages Look Like
